authority: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1 sections 9, 20.4.44, 20.4.45 and 20.4.54: HEADER plotstyle dictionary hard pointer; dictionary and default-entry roles; layer plotstyle hard pointer. Placeholder ownership is witnessed in the producer controls. The LAYER section says its default points to a PLACEHOLDER.
independent_producer: ODA File Converter 27.1.0 converted a locally authored LINE DXF to DWG. LibreDWG 0.14 independently decoded the resulting graph. No resulting drawing is committed.
graph: HEADER hard pointer and NOD ACAD_PLOTSTYLENAME soft-owner entry both target DICTIONARYWDFLT; it has a Normal soft-owner entry and default hard pointer to ACDBPLACEHOLDER; placeholder owner soft-points back to the dictionary; LAYER plotstyle hard-points to the placeholder.
null_plotstyle_search: LibreDWG decoded 20 local source drawings and 172 LAYER plotstyle references; all were nonzero hard pointers. This sample search does not prove null plotstyle impossible. Do not promote the typed-null scratch candidate as source-backed behavior.

scratch_graph.reader_result: LibreDWG decoded matching HEADER, NOD, dictionary, default, placeholder, parent, and LAYER references; ODA produced no DXF and reported Object improperly read: <AcDbLinetypeTableRecord> (F), previous error .dwg file needs recovery.
scratch_graph.limits: The candidate explicitly registers the class and allocates scratch identities; it is not an automatic production writer implementation.

remaining_implementation_work: Admit default graph only after caller class/NOD registrations and explicit handle reservations, but before class manifest freeze and HEADER emission; safely skip synthesis when a validated source/caller plotstyle graph is provided.

Allocate and reserve distinct output identities transactionally, register the DICTIONARYWDFLT class instance, account for class ordinal conflicts, and fail closed on case-insensitive name or identity ambiguity.
Encode HEADER and default synthetic layer references to the selected graph only when that graph is complete; do not replace explicit caller/source layer values.

Emit and validate NOD dictionary edge, DICTIONARYWDFLT Normal and default edges, and PLACEHOLDER parent; integrate graph state with existing class-count, handle-map, rollback, retry, and adapter retention checks.

Test all six versions, supplied-graph override, unknown or malformed source graph, collision/late-registration failures, no-output rollback and same-writer retry, exact wire roles, LibreCAD-compatible consumers, independent physical readback, and final ODA output/error.
qualification: This graph evidence advances one ODA failure boundary but does not establish successful DWG conversion or full support.
